extract.description: A stone chipped the windscreen while driving.

followup.question: On what date did this happen? Were the police informed, and were there any witnesses?

compose.answer: In claim_types_policy.pdf, page 3, the fictional wording excludes this own-vehicle event for the selected liability-only test product [P.3]. Page 6 provides no own-vehicle compensation for that product [P.6]. A claims handler must check the case.
next_steps: A human claims handler reviews the case.
